name: Combobox
description: Text input that filters a list of options as you type. Supports multi-select tags, async loading and long, virtualized lists.

errorMessage.description: Shown when the field is invalid.

placeholder.description: Hint shown in the empty input.

selectionMode.description: multiple shows the chosen options as removable tags.

value.description: Controlled selection: one key (or null) in single mode, an array of keys in multiple mode.

allowsCustomValue.description: Lets the user keep text that doesn't match an option (single mode).

menuTrigger.description: What opens the list: typing, focusing, or only the button and arrow keys.

isLoading.description: Shows a spinner in the field, e.g. while an async search runs.

virtualized.description: Renders only visible options. Turn on for lists of more than a few hundred items.

emptyMessage.description: Shown when nothing matches the input.

isDisabled.description: Prevents interaction and dims the field.

isInvalid.description: Marks the field invalid and shows errorMessage.

isRequired.description: Requires a selection for form submission.

onLoadMore.description: Called when the user scrolls near the end of the list, for infinite loading.

keyboard: Down arrow opens the list; Up/Down arrows move through options
Enter selects, Esc closes and restores the input
Backspace in an empty input removes the last tag (multiple mode)
requirements: Input is labelled and announces the number of results
Each tag has a remove button named 'Remove <option>'
screenReader: On focus: the label, combo box, and collapsed or expanded
Typing announces the number of results or the focused option
Moving through options announces each option and its position; in the 5,000-item list, positions like 4,999 of 5,000
No matches: No results is announced
Async: Loading is announced while results load
Multiple: each tag's button is announced as Remove <option>; removing one with Backspace makes its removal clear

use_when: Choosing from a long or searchable list, like countries, users or products
avoid_when: Fewer than about 7 options: use Select or RadioGroup
anti_patterns: Async search without a loading state
Rendering thousands of options without virtualized

Passing isInvalid for required or format checks (even isInvalid={false}): any defined value takes over validity and hides the built-in errors. Use isRequired and validate; pass isInvalid only for errors the app finds itself, such as from the server
